description: Make an AI spokesperson video from a product photo or a product link. Choose a presenter and a voice, then download a talking ad for TikTok or Meta.
h1: AI Spokesperson Video: Explain One Product Point on Camera
lead: One product photo can still become two spoken ads you can test. AIVideosUGC puts an AI actor on camera with your line.

benefits.d: A running-shoe ad can run on TikTok with the actor saying the cushion line. A second export in another language you sell does not mean hiring again.

benefits.t: A Voice on the Product Page
benefits.d: Next to the coffee-maker photo, the actor can answer the question buyers ask in chat. That answer stays on the page.

benefits.t: The Same Face in the Feed
benefits.d: Monday's lipstick clip can show the bullet. Friday can show the same actor with a new sentence about the shade. The face stays so the feed still looks like your shop.
The actor can show an air fryer's basket, then the dial, then the start button, in that order. When a step changes, replace that sentence and publish the guide again.

steps_h2: How to Make an AI Spokesperson Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: A product photo and one sentence are enough to leave with a clip.

steps.t: Add a Photo or a Link

faq.q: What is an AI spokesperson video?
faq.a: It is a short clip of an AI actor saying your product sentence on camera. You start from a photo or the product page, and you approve the line before it posts.

faq.q: How does the clip get built from a script?
faq.a: Type the line, pick who says it, and you get a clip you can download. Captions can ride along for viewers watching with the sound off.

faq.q: Which placements can use an AI actor?
faq.a: Paid ads, product pages, social feeds, short guides, training clips, and lessons. The same presenter can explain a feature, a setup step, or an offer.

faq.q: Is an AI actor a good fit for an explainer?
faq.a: Yes. The actor can explain the same feature the same way on every render, which matters when the page and the ad must agree.

faq.q: Can I use one for training or onboarding?
faq.a: Yes. If a step changes, replace that sentence and render the lesson again. Each team can watch the same new cut.

faq.q: How do brands keep a social feed going?
faq.a: They keep one actor as the face and change the line from post to post. The next clip does not mean booking the product again.

faq.q: Can I change the face, the voice, or the language?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a different age, outfit, or voice, including a voice for another language you sell in.

faq.q: Can I run the clip commercially?
faq.a: Yes. Finished clips on a paid plan are yours to use in ads, with no watermark. If a render fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: What should a shop be careful about?
faq.a: Do not let the actor pretend to be a customer who bought the product. If you build a custom face, use only photos you have permission to use, and say only what is true of the item you ship.

definition.title: What Is an AI Spokesperson Video?
paras: An AI spokesperson video is your sales sentence, said on camera by an AI actor you picked. You are not hiring someone to stand in for the product.
Use it as a 9:16 clip on the product page, or as a 1:1 cut for a feed test. 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 are available when the placement asks.

reasons.h2: Why Shops Use an AI Spokesperson
reasons.lead: A product page that is only a photo can get a spoken line without a studio day.

more_sections.h2: What You Control Before the Ad Goes Out
more_sections.lead: The line, the voice, the captions, and the person on camera, plus a way to start from your own tools.

items.d: Your email sentence about a backpack's laptop sleeve can be the script, tightened to the words you would actually say.
A lower voice lets a candle's scent line sound like a recommendation. A bright promo voice makes it sound like a toy.
Captions let a protein-powder line be read with the sound off. A music track from the library can sit under the voice.
Pick a presenter and a setting, or build a custom actor for the brand. Keep that person as the face of later ads.

items.t: Links, a Catalog, and an API
items.d: Start from a product link or a photo, and make one clip per item. An API lets your shop software request the clips.
A scarf that also sells in Spanish can keep the same point, switch the voice to that language, and go out again. You do not refilm the product.
